title: Light Pickled Canadian Sardines Chowder
description: A peppery, creamy, light Canadian dish featuring sardines, mirepoix-base, halal-friendly, served in an agave leaf. Perfect for a light meal or snack.

ingredients.name: Sardines in water, drained and flaked
Agave leaf
ingredients.notes: for serving, large enough to hold the chowder

instructions: Sauté the sardines in a pan over medium heat until lightly browned.
Add the diced onions, carrots, and celery to the pan and cook until tender.
Add the diced potatoes, chicken broth, and heavy cream to the pan and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let cook for 10 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
